title: About Me
descriptions: I’m Alfin, a software engineer based in Malang with a degree in computer science from Institut Teknologi dan Bisnis ASIA. I have worked on web interfaces, mobile apps, and the APIs that connect them. Today, I focus on frontend product development.

At PT Ada Ide Langsung Jalan, I develop features for Smartlink and Groapp products, including Smartlink Kasir, Smartlink Owner, Groapp Access, and Groapp Accounting. I work with product owners and backend engineers to turn requirements into responsive interfaces, reliable API integrations, and reusable components.

From January 2022 to July 2026, I led a frontend engineering team, planning work, mentoring engineers, reviewing code, and setting technical standards. I also publish tools for localization, UI testing, and form validation based on recurring challenges in product development.
